Element: Aurora. VFX: kept on the body (Epic): the five aurora ribbons of the crest, the ear
tips and the tail tip glow and step through violet, mint and pink every 6 s (the glow cycle: it
purrs in colours); an aurora trail waves off the crest 2 studs back (Effects.luau, the Trail
from Top to Tail) and motes drift up off it at 5 a second (the Glow emitter at Top); a light on
the body in the aurora colours; the crest sways, the ears turn, the tail swings; a slow blink
